neighbours.label: The word-piece just before n't in a contraction, the stems ending in -n: don, didn, doesn, isn, wasn, aren, weren, haven, hasn, couldn, wouldn, shouldn, won (fires about 0.9 in any sentence). can't, mustn't and ain't stay quiet, and so does 'not' written out (do not, is not). It also fires on 'well' in 'as well as', 'such' in 'such as', and 'according' in 'according to'. Ordinary text idles at about 0.2-0.35, and a comma right after an opening word (Frankly, ...) can reach 0.6.
